rationale.consistency: Perfectly matches the module registration, Caddyfile unmarshalling, interface assertions, and structure of the existing cookie filter.
rationale.edge_cases: Elegantly handles quotes, missing attributes, unparseable lines, and prioritizes the first matching action perfectly.
rationale.scope: Implements exactly the set_cookie filter with the requested actions and behavior, with zero unrelated changes.
rationale.readability: Clean structure using strings.Cut and an OUTER loop label makes the flow, string manipulation, and logic very clear.
rationale.robustness: Safely handles malformed strings, avoids index out-of-bounds panics via strings.Cut, and correctly pre-allocates slices.
rationale.maintainability: Modular actions loop and straightforward parsing logic make it simple to extend or modify in the future.
